name: file-tree

frames.best_why: Both nested folders are open with every file in view, giving the fullest picture of the tree.

tagline: Nested folders open in place to reveal the files inside.
summary: A compact panel listing folders and files with small icons and stepped indentation. Clicking a folder unfolds it to show its contents, and clicking any row highlights it as selected.
appearance: A rounded dark card holds rows of pale grey names, each led by a small line-drawn folder or document icon. Children sit indented beneath their folder, joined by a thin vertical rule, and the active row gets a slightly lighter rounded backing.
behaviour: Pressing a folder name slides it open or shut, exposing or hiding the rows underneath. Pressing a file marks that row selected; the tree keeps its own open and selected state until changed again.
demo_content: A src tree with components (Button.tsx, Input.tsx, Modal.tsx), pages, and root files package.json and tsconfig.json
search_phrases: nested folders you can click open
file explorer panel in a web app
use_when: Browsing a nested hierarchy such as project files or docs sections inside a bounded panel.
avoid_when: Flat lists, or deep trees on narrow screens where indentation crowds out the names.
customise: Pass an elements array of ids, names and children; initial selection, initially open folders, open and close icons, sorting and direction are props.
weight_why: A handful of rows animated by CSS height keyframes; nothing runs in the background.

a11y.note: Rows behave as flat buttons in an accordion, so no tree role, level or expanded state is announced.

issues: The selected-row highlight is only a shade lighter than the panel, so it is easy to miss.
polish_why: The structure reads cleanly and expansion is tidy; the faint selection highlight is the weak spot.
title: File Tree
